To determine the year a child born in 5 B.C. turns 15, we must account for the fact that the Gregorian/Julian calendar has no year zero. 

- From 5 B.C. to 1 B.C. spans 4 years.
- From 1 B.C. to 1 A.D. spans 1 year.
- This accounts for 5 years total. To reach an age of 15, we need 10 additional years into the A.D. era.
- Adding 10 years to 1 A.D. gives us 11 A.D.

<answer>11 A.D.</answer>
